As Amazon.Com (AMZN) Shares Rose, Shareholder Windward Capital Management Company Has Lowered Holding by $14.09 Million; E&G Advisors LP Holds Stake in Raytheon Co (RTN)
May 31, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
E&G Advisors Lp increased its stake in Raytheon Co (RTN) by 99.15% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. E&G Advisors Lp bought 2,325 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.91% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,670 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.01 million, up from 2,345 at the end of the previous reported quarter. E&G Advisors Lp who had been investing in Raytheon Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $60.53B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.76% or $1.61 during the last trading session, reaching $210.71. About 395,800 shares traded. Raytheon Company (NYSE:RTN) has risen 29.53% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.96% the S&P500.
Windward Capital Management Company decreased its stake in Amazon.Com Inc (AMZN) by 25.5% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Windward Capital Management Company sold 9,737 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 28,451 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $41.18M, down from 38,188 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Windward Capital Management Company who had been investing in Amazon.Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $792.01B market cap company. The stock increased 0.45% or $7.35 during the last trading session, reaching $1632.24. About 1.93M shares traded. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 62.09% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.52% the S&P500.
Windward Capital Management Company, which manages about $686.42M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,410 shares to 325,342 shares, valued at $54.59M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 7,363 shares in the quarter, for a total of 23,437 shares, and has risen its stake in Pfizer Inc (NYSE:PFE).
Analysts await Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) to report earnings on July, 26. They expect $2.42 EPS, up 505.00% or $2.02 from last year’s $0.4 per share. AMZN’s profit will be $1.17B for 168.62 P/E if the $2.42 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.27 actual EPS reported by Amazon.com, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -25.99% negative EPS growth.
